p5.caption:
What makes a good clip? 🎬

1️⃣ A strong hook in the first 3 seconds
2️⃣ One clear idea per clip
3️⃣ Readable captions on screen
4️⃣ Short and tight, no filler
5️⃣ A clear next step at the end
